issue.title: Enforce Dev UI charset to UTF-8
issue.body:
@cescoffier @phillip-kruger this is a tentative fix for #38650

I'm not fluent in Kafka so I wasn't sure how to reproduce the issue. Also there's a good chance it requires to start the browser with a non-UTF-8 locale.

body:
I created https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/38653 to fix it.

I would be either interested in a small Maven reproducer to check it myself or that you try to build my PR following (roughly) the instructions here: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#building-main .
I merged the PR in main as it's something we want anyway. If you follow the instructions in ^, you should be able to check if it fixes the issue.

OK, I can reproduce the issue with the reproducer.

@phillip-kruger I'm not exactly sure where the problem is but we probably need you to have a look. At some point, we have something in the Dev UI transport layer transforming the UTF-8 content to something else.
